claim.claim-text: 1. Sensor arrangement (29, 59, 69, 79, 120, 140, 229) for a foreign object detection device (119) for a wireless power transfer system including:

a) a current input (135, 142) and a current output (136, 143), b) a multitude of detection cells (30-41, 144.1-144.4), each comprising a sense coil (1, 2, 3, 20, 22, 24) including a winding spirally wound in a plane and having a multitude of turns, c) wherein the sense coils (1, 2, 3, 20, 22, 24) are arranged in one or more layers and wherein the sense coils (1, 2, 3, 20, 22, 24) of a particular layer are arranged in a matrix-like structure with multiple rows and multiple columns, d) a multitude of input leads (50 - 53, 60 - 62, 127, 148a, 148b, 251 - 258) and one or more output leads (56, 57, 58, 66, 67, 128, 150a, 150b, 259), wherein each detection cell (30-41, 144.1-144.4) is connected between one of the input leads and one output lead and wherein each detection cell is connected to a different combination of input and output leads, e) an input selection circuit (125, 152) adapted to selectively establish an electrical connection between the current input (135, 142) and one or more of the input leads,characterized in that

the input lead (50 - 53, 60 - 62, 251 - 258) and the output lead (56, 57, 58, 66, 67, 259) of at least one sense coil (1, 2, 3, 20, 22, 24) is routed through the matrix-like structure to which the at least one sense coil belongs close to each other such as to reduce an area parallel to said matrix-like structure and enclosed by said input and output leads.

2. Sensor arrangement (29, 59, 69, 79, 120, 140, 229) according to claim 1, wherein the input leads (50 - 53, 251 - 258) and the output leads (56, 57, 58, 259) of each sense coil of a particular layer are routed through a gap between two columns or two rows, preferably between two central columns or two central rows, of the matrix-like structure.

3. Sensor arrangement (29, 59, 69, 79, 120, 140, 229) according to any one of claims 1 or 2, wherein a distance between the input lead (50 - 53, 60 - 62, 251 - 258) and the output lead (56, 57, 58, 66, 67, 259) of said at least one sense coil is smaller than a distance between two rows or two columns of the matrix-like structure.

4. Sensor arrangement (29, 59, 69, 79, 120, 140, 229) according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the input lead and the output lead of said at least one sense coil are arranged one above the other.
5. Sensor arrangement (29, 59, 69, 79, 120, 140, 229) according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the input lead and the output lead of the at least one sense coil are twisted at least once.

6. Sensor arrangement (29, 59, 69, 79, 120, 140, 229) according to any one of the previous claims, including an output selection circuit (126, 153) adapted to selectively establish an electrical connection between one or more of the output leads and the current output (136, 143).
7. Sensor arrangement (29, 59, 69, 79, 120, 140, 229) according to any one of the previous claims, wherein the sense coil (20, 24) of the at least one detection cell has a rectangular shape.
8. A foreign object detection device (119) for a primary part of a wireless power transfer system for transferring power over an air gap to a nearby receiver, including:

a) a sensor arrangement (29, 59, 69, 79, 120, 140, 229) according to any of the claims 1- 7, b) a stimulus circuit (121) for generating a predetermined stimulation signal, connected to a current input (142) of the sensor arrangement (29, 59, 69, 79, 120, 140, 229), c) a measurement unit (122), adapted to sense an electrical signal applied to said current input, the measurement unit (122) including an analogue to digital converter for acquiring sampling data representing the sensed electrical signal, and d) a signal processing unit (123) configured to determine time response data of a selected detection cell based on the sampling data acquired by the measurement unit.

9. A primary part for a wireless power transfer system for transferring power over an air gap to a nearby receiver, configured to generate a magnetic field in an active area at a transmission frequency, the primary part including the sensor arrangement (29, 59, 69, 79, 120, 140, 229) according to any one of claims 1 -7 or the foreign object detection device (119) according to claim 8, wherein the sense coils (1, 2, 3, 20, 22, 24) are arranged in a way that a sensing area defined by the sense coils at least partly covers the active area, preferably the sensing area entirely covers the active area.
